## Specification

### Component: Input OTP

A one-time-code field: one box per character, a single real `<input>` underneath. Paste, SMS autofill, password managers and forms keep working because the browser only sees one text input.

#### Anatomy
```
<InputOTP>                     div.ui-otp (position: relative, inline-flex, data-size|invalid|disabled)
  div.ui-otp-group             aria-hidden, one per group
    div.ui-otp-slot          x N: data-active, data-filled; holds the character
      span.ui-otp-caret        blinking caret in the active EMPTY slot
  span.ui-otp-separator        between groups (default: a short dash)
  input.ui-otp-input           the real input, stretched over everything, transparent
```

#### Props
- `length` (6), `groups` (e.g. `[3, 3]`, overrides length), `separator`, `pattern` (`digits` | `alphanumeric`), `value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange`, `onComplete`, `invalid`, `size` (`sm` 32×40 | `md` 40×48 | `lg` 48×56), plus native input props (`name`, `disabled`, `autoFocus`, `aria-label` default "One-time code").

#### Behaviour
- The input has `autocomplete="one-time-code"`, `inputMode="numeric"` (`text` for alphanumeric), `pattern`, `autocapitalize="off"`, font-size 16px (no iOS zoom). Text and caret are transparent.
- Typing filters characters by the pattern and cuts to the length. The active slot is the caret position: empty slot at the end of the value, otherwise the selected character (typing overwrites it).
- Left/Right/Home/End move the active slot; Backspace deletes. Clicking a slot places the caret there (the pointer's x is matched to the slot rectangles).
- Paste replaces the whole value with the cleaned clipboard text (non-allowed characters and spaces dropped) and fills every slot.
- `onComplete(value)` runs once when the value reaches full length.

#### Visual rules
- Slot: `--ui-background` (5% foreground tint in dark), 1px `--ui-border-strong`, `--radius-md`, `--ui-shadow-xs` (none in dark), 20px/500 tabular numbers; gap 6px inside a group, 8px between groups.
- Active slot: border `--ui-ring` + 3px ring `color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent)`. Invalid: border `--ui-destructive`, ring 30% destructive. Disabled: opacity .5, muted fill.
- Caret: 1px × 20px `--ui-foreground`, blinks 1.1s steps(1).

#### Motion
- Border and ring cross-fade 150ms. The caret blink ends visible under reduced motion.

#### Accessibility
- One labelled text input; boxes are `aria-hidden`. `aria-invalid` when `invalid`.

#### Acceptance checks
- Typing 6 digits fills six boxes, fires `onComplete` once; letters are rejected under `digits`.
- Pasting `482-913` fills all six boxes; Backspace removes the last digit; arrows move the active box.
- Clicking the third box makes it active. Invalid shows red boxes. No axe violations in light and dark.

### `ui/components/input-otp/input-otp.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  Fragment,
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ChangeEvent,
  type ClipboardEvent,
  type InputHTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type MouseEvent,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { activeSlotIndex, resolveGroups, sanitizeOTP, type OTPPattern } from './otp-utils';

export interface InputOTPProps
  extends Omit<InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'value' | 'defaultValue' | 'onChange' | 'size' | 'pattern' | 'maxLength' | 'type'> {
  /** Number of characters. Ignored when `groups` is set (the sum is used). Default 6. */
  length?: number;
  /** Slots per group, e.g. `[3, 3]` renders `___ - ___`. */
  groups?: number[];
  /** Shown between groups. Default: a short dash. */
  separator?: ReactNode;
  /** Allowed characters. Default `digits`. */
  pattern?: OTPPattern;
  value?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
  /** Called once when every slot is filled. */
  onComplete?: (value: string) => void;
  /** Error state: red slots and `aria-invalid`. */
  invalid?: boolean;
  /** Slot size: 32×40 / 40×48 / 48×56. Default `md`. */
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
}

/**
 * InputOTP — one box per character over a single real `<input>`
 * (autocomplete="one-time-code"), so paste, SMS autofill, password managers and
 * forms all work. The slots are only the visual layer.
 */
export const InputOTP = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, InputOTPProps>(function InputOTP(
  {
    length = 6,
    groups,
    separator,
    pattern = 'digits',
    value,
    defaultValue = '',
    onValueChange,
    onComplete,
    invalid,
    size = 'md',
    disabled,
    className,
    autoComplete = 'one-time-code',
    'aria-label': ariaLabel = 'One-time code',
    onFocus,
    onBlur,
    onKeyDown,
    onClick,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const sizes = resolveGroups(length, groups);
  const total = sizes.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const composedRef = useComposedRefs(ref, inputRef);
  const slotsRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const [code, setCode] = useControllableState<string>({
    value: value === undefined ? undefined : sanitizeOTP(value, pattern, total),
    defaultValue: sanitizeOTP(defaultValue, pattern, total),
    onChange: onValueChange,
  });
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false);
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);

  /** Put the caret in slot `i`: select its character so typing overwrites it. */
  const place = useCallback(
    (i: number) => {
      const el = inputRef.current;
      if (!el) return;
      const at = Math.max(0, Math.min(i, el.value.length, total - 1));
      const end = at < el.value.length ? at + 1 : at;
      if (el.selectionStart !== at || el.selectionEnd !== end) el.setSelectionRange(at, end);
      setActive(at);
    },
    [total],
  );

  const sync = useCallback(() => {
    const el = inputRef.current;
    if (!el || document.activeElement !== el) return;
    place(activeSlotIndex(el.selectionStart, el.value.length, total));
  }, [place, total]);

  // After the value changes (typing, paste, controlled update) re-place the caret
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    sync();
  }, [code, sync]);

  const commit = (next: string) => {
    const clean = sanitizeOTP(next, pattern, total);
    const changed = clean !== code;
    setCode(clean);
    if (changed && clean.length === total) onComplete?.(clean);
  };

  const handleChange = (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    commit(e.target.value);
    requestAnimationFrame(sync);
  };

  const handlePaste = (e: ClipboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    commit(e.clipboardData.getData('text'));
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    onKeyDown?.(e);
    if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
    const len = code.length;
    const move = (i: number) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      place(i);
    };
    // Arrows move between slots (a selected character would otherwise collapse the caret)
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') move(active - 1);
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') move(Math.min(active + 1, len));
    else if (e.key === 'Home') move(0);
    else if (e.key === 'End') move(len);
  };

  const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    onClick?.(e);
    // The input covers the slots: find the slot under the pointer
    const slots = slotsRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.ui-otp-slot');
    if (!slots) return;
    let hit = -1;
    slots.forEach((s, i) => {
      const r = s.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (e.clientX >= r.left && e.clientX <= r.right) hit = i;
    });
    if (hit === -1) hit = e.clientX < slots[0]!.getBoundingClientRect().left ? 0 : slots.length - 1;
    place(hit);
  };

  let index = 0;
  return (
    <div
      ref={slotsRef}
      className={cn('ui-otp', className)}
      data-size={size === 'md' ? undefined : size}
      data-invalid={invalid || undefined}
      data-disabled={disabled || undefined}
    >
      {sizes.map((groupSize, g) => (
        <Fragment key={g}>
          {g > 0 && (
            <span className="ui-otp-separator" aria-hidden="true">
              {separator ?? <span className="ui-otp-dash" />}
            </span>
          )}
          <div className="ui-otp-group" aria-hidden="true">
            {Array.from({ length: groupSize }, () => {
              const i = index++;
              const char = code[i];
              const isActive = focused && !disabled && active === i;
              return (
                <div
                  key={i}
                  className="ui-otp-slot"
                  data-active={isActive || undefined}
                  data-filled={char ? true : undefined}
                >
                  {char}
                  {isActive && !char && <span className="ui-otp-caret" />}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </Fragment>
      ))}
      <input
        ref={composedRef}
        className="ui-otp-input"
        type="text"
        inputMode={pattern === 'digits' ? 'numeric' : 'text'}
        pattern={pattern === 'digits' ? '[0-9]*' : '[a-zA-Z0-9]*'}
        autoComplete={autoComplete}
        autoCapitalize="off"
        autoCorrect="off"
        spellCheck={false}
        value={code}
        disabled={disabled}
        aria-label={ariaLabel}
        aria-invalid={invalid || undefined}
        onChange={handleChange}
        onPaste={handlePaste}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        onClick={handleClick}
        onSelect={sync}
        onFocus={(e) => {
          setFocused(true);
          onFocus?.(e);
          // Safari places the caret after focus; wait a frame
          requestAnimationFrame(sync);
        }}
        onBlur={(e) => {
          setFocused(false);
          onBlur?.(e);
        }}
        {...props}
      />
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/input-otp/otp-utils.ts`

```ts
export type OTPPattern = 'digits' | 'alphanumeric';

const ALLOWED: Record<OTPPattern, RegExp> = {
  digits: /[^0-9]/g,
  alphanumeric: /[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g,
};

/** Drop characters the pattern does not allow, then cut to `length`. */
export function sanitizeOTP(raw: string, pattern: OTPPattern, length: number): string {
  return raw.replace(ALLOWED[pattern], '').slice(0, length);
}

/** Where the caret sits for a given selection start: the slot to mark active. */
export function activeSlotIndex(selectionStart: number | null, valueLength: number, length: number): number {
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(selectionStart ?? valueLength, valueLength, length - 1));
}

/** Slot sizes for `groups`, or one group of `length`. */
export function resolveGroups(length: number, groups?: number[]): number[] {
  const clean = (groups ?? []).filter((g) => g > 0);
  return clean.length ? clean : [length];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

'use client';

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect } from 'react';

/** useLayoutEffect in the browser, useEffect on the server (no SSR warning). */
export const useIsomorphicLayoutEffect = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? useLayoutEffect : useEffect;

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/input-otp.css`

```css
/* Input OTP ---------------------------------------------------------------
   .ui-otp > (.ui-otp-group > .ui-otp-slot)+ with .ui-otp-separator between groups,
   plus ONE real input.ui-otp-input stretched over the slots (transparent).
   Slot state: [data-active] [data-filled]; root: [data-invalid] [data-disabled]
   Sizes: [data-size="sm|lg"] (md default): 32x40 / 40x48 / 48x56
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-otp {
    --ui-otp-w: 2.5rem;
    --ui-otp-h: 3rem;
    --ui-otp-border: var(--ui-border-strong);
    --ui-otp-bg: var(--ui-background);
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    max-width: 100%;
  }
  .ui-otp[data-size="sm"] { --ui-otp-w: 2rem; --ui-otp-h: 2.5rem; }
  .ui-otp[data-size="lg"] { --ui-otp-w: 3rem; --ui-otp-h: 3.5rem; }
  :where(.dark, [data-theme-mode="dark"]) .ui-otp { --ui-otp-bg: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 5%, transparent); }

  .ui-otp-group { display: flex; gap: 0.375rem; }

  .ui-otp-slot {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: var(--ui-otp-w);
    height: var(--ui-otp-h);
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-otp-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background-color: var(--ui-otp-bg);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-xl);
    font-weight: 500;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-xs);
    transition:
      border-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  :where(.dark, [data-theme-mode="dark"]) .ui-otp-slot { box-shadow: none; }
  .ui-otp[data-size="sm"] .ui-otp-slot { font-size: var(--text-lg); }
  .ui-otp[data-size="lg"] .ui-otp-slot { font-size: var(--text-2xl); }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-otp:hover:not([data-disabled], [data-invalid]) .ui-otp-slot:not([data-active]) {
      border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-border-strong) 55%, var(--ui-foreground));
    }
  }

  .ui-otp-slot[data-active] {
    border-color: var(--ui-ring);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent);
    z-index: 1;
  }

  /* Blinking caret in the active, empty slot. Ends visible under reduced motion. */
  .ui-otp-caret {
    width: 1px;
    height: 1.25rem;
    background-color: var(--ui-foreground);
    animation: ui-otp-blink 1.1s steps(1, end) infinite;
  }
  @keyframes ui-otp-blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }

  .ui-otp-separator { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }
  .ui-otp-dash { width: 0.5rem; height: 2px; border-radius: 1px; background-color: currentColor; opacity: 0.7; }

  /* Invalid */
  .ui-otp[data-invalid] { --ui-otp-border: var(--ui-destructive); }
  .ui-otp[data-invalid] .ui-otp-slot[data-active] {
    border-color: var(--ui-destructive);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 30%, transparent);
  }

  .ui-otp[data-disabled] .ui-otp-slot { opacity: 0.5; background-color: var(--ui-surface-muted); box-shadow: none; }
  .ui-otp[data-disabled] { cursor: not-allowed; }

  /* The real input: invisible, covers every slot, keeps native paste / autofill / forms */
  .ui-otp-input {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 2;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: transparent;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    caret-color: transparent;
    font-size: 16px; /* >= 16px stops iOS zooming into the field */
    outline: none;
    cursor: text;
  }
  .ui-otp-input::selection { background: transparent; }
  .ui-otp-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; }
}
```

## Usage

**Verify a code** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/input-otp/verify.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { InputOTP } from '@/ui/components/input-otp';

export default function OtpVerify() {
  const [code, setCode] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'error' | 'ok'>('idle');

  const verify = (value: string) => {
    // Demo only: the right code is 482913
    setStatus(value === '482913' ? 'ok' : 'error');
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Enter the 6-digit code we sent to a•••@northwind.com</p>
      <InputOTP
        length={6}
        value={code}
        onValueChange={(v) => {
          setCode(v);
          setStatus('idle');
        }}
        onComplete={verify}
        invalid={status === 'error'}
        aria-label="Verification code"
      />
      <p
        className={status === 'error' ? 'text-sm text-destructive-text' : status === 'ok' ? 'text-sm text-success-text' : 'text-sm text-muted-foreground'}
        aria-live="polite"
      >
        {status === 'error' ? 'That code is incorrect. Try again.' : status === 'ok' ? 'Verified. Redirecting…' : 'Try 482913, or paste any 6 digits'}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```
